title: A panned canvas jumps to the top-left after the Model Library closes
description: MpiCanvas.resize() measures a container that is display:none (0x0) while the Model Library overlay stashes the workspace, so ViewManager.handleResize subtracts half the viewport on the way out and its oldW>0 guard skips the matching add on the way back. Net: a panned or zoomed view is displaced by -(w/2, h/2) and reads as 'the canvas is at the top left'. Reported by the user 2026-08-21.
acceptance: A panned/zoomed canvas keeps its exact framing across an open+close of the Model Library overlay
The fix is in the measurement, not a re-centre on overlay close - a hidden container is not a resize
A managed (unpanned) view still refits to the container after a real resize
Verified live in a browser harness that hides and restores the canvas container
